headline: Hurts and Hall are ruled out, Downs and McLaurin are cleared, so start Brissett and use Downs in a FLEX.
alerts: Jalen Hurts (calf) is OUT Sunday. Start Brissett at QB.
Breece Hall (quad) is OUT again. Keep him on the bench.
Josh Downs is off the injury report and McLaurin has no designation for Monday. Both are fine to start.
Penix is off the injury report and will start for Atlanta, good for Brian Robinson.
Sun 6:30 AM: Jaguars vs. Texans in London. None of your tracked players are in it.
Sun 10:00 AM: Robinson, Downs and Jets D lock. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Lloyd, Golden, Ferguson. Mon 5:15 PM: McLaurin.
No kicker shows in the tracked roster. Add one before Sunday 10:00 AM if you have not.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from the Tuesday run. Confirm your starters in the app.

ARI.note: At Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -12.5, total 51.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied. RB Jeremiyah Love is out.

PHI.note: Vs. Carolina Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Hurts and Barkley are out. Panthers now -3, total 39.5.

ATL.note: Vs. Chicago Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bears -1.5, total 52.5, Falcons about 25.5 implied. Penix is off the report and will start.

LAC.note: At Kansas City Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Chiefs -7.5, total 41.5, Chargers about 17 implied. Tre Harris, Joe Alt and Derwin James are out.

GB.note: Vs. Dallas Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Packers -1.5, total 53.5, about 27.5 implied. Skyy Moore is out.

DAL.note: At Green Bay Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Lamb practiced fully all week. CB Cobie Durant is out.

WAS.note: At San Francisco Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. 49ers -7.5, total 52.5. McLaurin has no designation, Diggs is questionable, Croskey-Merritt is out.

IND.note: Vs. Tennessee Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -7, total 44.5, about 26 implied. Downs is off the report.

NYJ.note: At New England Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Patriots -7.5, total 43.5. Hall is out.

JAX.note: Vs. Houston in London, Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. Jaguars -2.5, total 42.5. No rostered players.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Props: 242.5 passing yards, 1.5 TD with the over at +140, 36.5 attempts. About 14.5 points with about 1 INT.
Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog at the Rams, total 51.5, so pass volume should stay high.
RB Jeremiyah Love is out, which can push even more of the offense through the air.
Your only healthy QB this week with Hurts out. Kickoff Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific.

6904.name: Jalen Hurts
notes: Ruled OUT for Sunday with a calf injury. He practiced fully Wednesday, then missed Thursday and Friday.
Barkley is also out. Do not start Hurts, Brissett is your QB.

notes: Not on the Packers final injury report.

8154.name: Brian Robinson
notes: Penix was removed from the injury report and will start, which removes the main risk here.
Bears are now 1.5-point favorites, but the total climbed to 52.5, so Atlanta is about 25.5 implied.
Still the backup to Bijan Robinson, so he needs goal-line work to pay off.
Bears RB Kyle Monangai is out and Caleb Williams is questionable. Kickoff Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.

9511.name: Keaton Mitchell
notes: Not listed on the Chargers final report. McConkey also came off the report, but WR Tre Harris, LT Joe Alt and Derwin James are out.
